---
name: Data proposal or correction / 戦術データの追加・訂正
about: Propose a sourced concept, translation, relation or correction
---

## Concept and scope / 用語と範囲

Existing concept ID, if any; XV/sevens; attack/defence; new concept vs alias/variant.

## Public primary evidence / 一次資料

Links, publisher, access date, exact section/page/time locator. Summarize in your own words.
Do not paste copyrighted source paragraphs, screenshots or private playbooks.

## Supported claim vs interpretation / 記述と解釈

What does the source actually support? What is your editorial interpretation?

## Alternatives, uncertainty and limits / 例外・不確実性

## Rights and review / 権利とレビュー

Can the original proposed text be published under the existing CC BY 4.0 data license?
Do not identify another reviewer without their permission. No reviewer named means not expert-reviewed.
